summary: Audit + Validation Playbook for Support Routing Rules and Macro Template Rollouts
description: Issue summary: We need a repeatable audit and validation playbook for changes to internal support routing rules and macro/template rollouts. Impact: Recent small routing weight tweaks and a macro template update were deployed without automated validation; that caused a short spike in misrouted P2 tickets and two stale SLA overrides. Goal: produce a checklist + automated smoke tests and one-click remediation steps to catch regressions before they affect SRE/support queues.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a routing rule change that adds a new condition for 'customer_tier: dedicated' with a weight adjustment
2) Deploy macro template update that includes a new SLA macro expansion string
3) Observe support-console routing simulation - currently no E2E smoke test runs
4) Monitor support queue: notes, some P2s were assigned to the wrong support rotation during prior change
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: lack of regression tests for routing weight redistribution combined with template linting gaps
Checked audit logs: routing-service shows the commit ID but no automated verification step executed
Support-console simulation tool returns 'ok' for syntactic checks but does not execute a sample routing policy against real queue state
SLA orchestrator applied an override that did not match the new macro syntax, causing fallback to default SLA and stale 'waiting' flags
comments: Leah Morales (2026-03-10): Filing this after observing misrouted P2s during a midday template rollout. Need an owner for playbook and test automation.
Arjun Patel (2026-03-11): Triage done. Will draft playbook sections: pre-deploy validation, post-deploy smoke tests, rollback steps. Planning to add a canary simulation job to CI.
SRE Oncall (2026-03-11): Noted two incidents where SLA override timestamps were inconsistent with routing change time. Recommend adding timestamped assertions to smoke tests.
QA Automation (2026-03-12): Proposed test cases: synthetic ticket load with mixed tiers, template expansion validation against current SLA schema, end-to-end routing assertion for expected assignees.
next_steps: 1) Draft playbook doc and checklist in Confluence (owner: Arjun) - target 2026-03-19
